pages.title: Mixing
pages.text:
**Mixing** is a Mechanical Mixer stirring a Basin under it. It handles any shapeless crafting recipe plus extra recipes, like alloys.\
\
"Heated mixing" means a burner sits under the basin. Brass is the classic one: copper and zinc over a heated burner.
